name: nts-to-spotify
description: Heart a track on NTS, it lands in your Spotify Liked Songs — exact version only, or a push saying it's not there.

scripts.deploy: npx wrangler secret bulk .dev.vars && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.state:push: npx wrangler kv key put --binding STATE --remote nts-spotify:state --path "${NTS_SPOTIFY_STATE:-$HOME/.config/nts-to-spotify/state.json}"
